Method of Attack: Phishing attack using fake data breach notifications to trick users into downloading a fake Trezor Suite application that steals recovery seeds
Use of lookalike domains with Punycode characters to impersonate legitimate Trezor domains
Modified open-source Trezor Suite app prompting users to enter recovery seed which is then sent to attackers
Attack Vector: Phishing emails sent through compromised MailChimp opt-in newsletter
Fake websites including suite.xn--trzor-o51b.com, trezorwallet.org, trezor.us, and a Tor site
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Trezor Suite app signed by certificate from 'Neodym Oy'
Phishing emails claiming data breach affecting 106,856 customers
